evals.prompt: run a hygiene check on our jira board
assertions: Claude reads patterns/hygiene_check.md from the jira_hygiene patterns directory
Claude asks for a JQL filter and mode before running the check
Claude produces a report of missing or incorrect fields grouped by ticket
Claude offers auto-fix only after presenting the report
Claude calls getAccessibleAtlassianResources as the first action
Claude stops immediately when the MCP call fails
Claude tells the user to enable the Atlassian MCP server before retrying

evals.prompt: check the hygiene of sprint 66 tickets and fix any issues
assertions: Claude reads the hygiene_check pattern before proceeding
Claude runs searchJiraIssuesUsingJql with a sprint 66 filter
Claude checks each ticket against the minimum hygiene criteria (priority, story points, assignee, description, sprint, status)
Claude presents a report before applying any fixes
Claude confirms the list of auto-fixes with the user before applying
